response.overview: The story follows a widow with one child, Kak Pah, who rents out several rooms in her residence to single women Ros, Zurin, Ika and Lia. At the same time, Kak Pah wishes to find a daughter-in-law for her son, Adam. Ros is skilled at winning Kak Pah's heart, making her always referred to as a good tenant by Kak Pah. Ros actually has an intention to play tricks on Zurin, Ika and Lia. CAST The cast of the drama Calon Menantu Tuan Rumah
response.title: Calon Menantu Tuan Rumah
